description: Count the current jobs matching the filters, without listing them. This is the live count: it reads the job database as it is now, so use it for "how many jobs" and "which employers are hiring" questions, and prefer its numbers over market_lookup and market_breakdown, which read a daily snapshot. No account needed. To answer "which companies are hiring for X" or "how are these jobs split by ...", pass group_by: employer (company works too), work_arrangement (remote, hybrid or in_person), title, state (US), city (metro works too), country or employment_type. The answer then also has group_by, groups (the top 25 values by number of matching jobs, each with value and jobs), groups_from_jobs (how many matching jobs were grouped, at most 1,000, taken in the default list order), groups_sampled (true when more jobs matched than were grouped, so the counts are from a sample) and groups_unknown_jobs (grouped jobs with no known value). A job with several locations or postings can count under more than one value. group_by employer keeps its own keys: employers (each with employer_name, company_id and jobs), employers_from_jobs, employers_sampled and employers_unknown_jobs. When a filter is too broad to count exactly in time, count is an estimate: the answer then has count_is_estimate: true, count_margin (the 95% range either side of count) and count_note.

country.description: One or more two-letter country codes, comma-separated or as an array (US,CA).

employment_type.description: One or more employment type values, comma-separated or as an array.

first_seen_since.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time; jobs we first found on or after it. For a daily check for new jobs, pass the time of the last check.

near.description: A US place to search around: a ZIP code (78701), a city with its state (Austin, TX), or latitude,longitude. Use with radius_miles.

pay_min.description: Lowest yearly pay, in pay_currency (default USD). Hourly pay is about yearly / 2,080, so $45 an hour is about 93,600.

posted_since.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO time; jobs posted on or after it.

q.description: Words matched against title and description, ranked by relevance. Every word must match; for a list of skills where any may match, use description_advanced with OR, for example python OR sql OR "data analysis".

remote.description: true is the same as work_arrangement=remote.

state.description: US state, two letters (CA) or full name.

work_arrangement.description: remote, hybrid or in_person; comma-separate several.

group_by.description: Break the matching jobs down by employer (company), work_arrangement, title, state, city (metro), country or employment_type.

name: count_jobs
title: Count jobs
